paite: TOUPA, hon panpih in; Pathian limsakmi lah a-om nawnta ngal kei ua; mihing tate lak a kipan miginom lah amangta ngal ua.
heading: Lapu Lian A Ding, David La: Sheminith A Sak Ding / Panpihna Dia Thumna
english: For the Chief Musician; upon an eight-stringed lyre. A Psalm of David. Help, Yahweh; for the godly man ceases. For the faithful fail from among the children of men.

paite: Michih in a-invengte kiang ah thu bangmah lou maimai agengen ua; maitang phatna leh khemna lungtang pu in thu agen nak uhi.
english: Everyone lies to his neighbor. They speak with flattering lips, and with a double heart.

paite: TOUPA'N maitang phatna muk tengteng a-atkhe ding a, thu kisathei genna lei toh,
english: May Yahweh cut off all flattering lips, and the tongue that boasts,

paite: amau, i lei in i zou ding ua; i mukte eimah a ngei aka, kua ahia i tung a lal om? achi uhi.
english: who have said, “With our tongue we will prevail. Our lips are our own. Who is lord over us?”

paite: TOUPA'N, "Gentheite asimmoh ziak uleh, tagahte thum ziak in, ka thou pah dia; anuihsan uh bittak in ka omsak ding," achi hi.
english: “Because of the oppression of the weak and because of the groaning of the needy, I will now arise,” says Yahweh; “I will set him in safety from those who malign him.”

paite: TOUPA thute thu siangthoutak ahi a; dangka leitung a haltuina mei a etkhiak a, sagihvei hihsiangthou zohsa bang ahi.
english: Yahweh’s words are flawless words, as silver refined in a clay furnace, purified seven times.

paite: TOUPA aw, nang amau na kemhoih ding a, hiai khangte lak ah chik lai peuh in leng na humbit ding.
english: You will keep them, Yahweh. You will preserve them from this generation forever.

paite: Mihing tate lak ah khelhna pahtawi a a-om in, migilou-salou avialvak nak uhi.
english: The wicked walk on every side, when what is vile is exalted among the sons of men.
